data.one_liner: Source code generator for compile-time dependency injection using annotations.
data.what_it_does: Reads @inject, @component, and @module annotations to generate fully wired, type-safe dependency components at build time. It eliminates runtime reflection and global state, supporting constructor injection and Flutter view-model factories.
use_when: You want compile-time safety and validation for your dependencies
You prefer explicit constructor injection over runtime service locators
You are building a Flutter application that can benefit from build_runner code generation
avoid_when: You cannot use build_runner or code generation in your workflow
You prefer runtime service locators like get_it
strengths: Zero runtime overhead and no reflection (no dart:mirrors)
Compile-time validation catches missing bindings and cycles early
Strong Flutter integration via inject_flutter and ViewModelFactory
weaknesses: Requires running build_runner after annotation changes
Generated code adds build artifacts to your project
data.setup_notes: Add inject_annotation, dev dependency inject_generator, and build_runner to your pubspec.yaml, then run build_runner.
